about: Per-drive CI durations in seconds: the MEDIAN across the four most recent full-battery branch runs at measurement time (42341651348, 42344572278, 42346679485, 42349071557), computed from the timestamped drive-completion lines in each shard job's log (a drive's duration is its completion line's timestamp minus the previous drive's; n=3-4 samples per drive). Measured for Beta 1.136 (programme E) - before this, the four shard lists were hand-kept and had drifted to 359/133/289/245 s. Refresh by re-measuring recent runs and re-running scripts/gen-shards.py. Drives absent from this map (new drives) are assigned the median of the measured set by the generator until their first CI runs land.
